problem.question: How can an ontology-grounded pipeline identify WHY a generated molecule is non-synthesizable and edit it into a synthesizable analogue while preserving pharmacophoric anchors, stereochemistry and binding interactions?

three_questions.Q3: what must not be touched during editing

syncraft.title: SynCraft: Guiding Large Language Models to Predict Edit Sequences for Molecular Synthesizability Optimization

fidelity_levels.L1_symbolic: claims about ontology structure, axioms, class/property definitions and inference rules; verifiable by the reasoner without any measured number
fidelity_levels.L2_numerical: claims that assert a specific quantity taken verbatim from CONTEXT; no arithmetic beyond restating exact fractions
fidelity_levels.L3_qualitative: claims about mechanism, adequacy or comparative merit that CONTEXT supports only indirectly; these are the claims most exposed to downgrade

L1_symbolic.claim: The ontology defines the class ValidatedEditSequence, i.e. an edit is representable as a sequence that has passed validation.
The ontology defines the class StereocenterPreservingReaction, i.e. stereocentre preservation is modelled as a reaction class rather than an ad-hoc filter.
The ontology carries a StereocenterAnchor contract, i.e. stereocentre anchoring is expressed as a contract on the anchor rather than as free text.
The ontology exposes the property hasRequiredOperation with SET_CHIRAL as an asserted value, so a required stereochemical operation is machine-readable.
The ontology exposes hasFailureRisk, giving a machine-readable slot for the 'why it cannot be made' question (Q2).
The ontology exposes hasProtectedAtom, giving a machine-readable slot for the 'what must not be touched' question (Q3).
An OWL RL reasoner (owlrl) is part of the pipeline and materialises inferences over the ontology, so the symbolic layer is not merely asserted but derived.
The pipeline is ontology-grounded in the sense that an 'ontology' arm exists as a distinct condition alongside similarity and random baselines.
The ontology constructs map onto the three sub-questions as hasFailureRisk→Q2, hasProtectedAtom→Q3, hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL→stereochemistry constraint.
L1_symbolic.note: This mapping is an interpretation of this phase, not a statement present in CONTEXT; downgraded from asserted symbolic structure to inferred correspondence (see DOWNGRADE D1).

L2_numerical.claim: On hardOK_48api the ontology arm scores 0.875 against 0.5 for similarity and 0.5 for random.
The reported significance is 6 wins 0 losses, exact sign test p=0.0156, and end2end 7 wins 0 losses p=0.0078.
L2_numerical.derived_check: Consistent with a one-sided exact sign test: (1/2)^6 = 0.015625 ≈ 0.0156 and (1/2)^7 = 0.0078125 ≈ 0.0078. Two-sided would give 0.03125 and 0.015625. CONTEXT does not state sidedness.

L2_numerical.claim: end2edit_validity is 1.0 for ontology, 1.0 for ontology_lora and 0.5 for syncraft, with source=null.
L2_numerical.caveat: No denominator is reported, so 1.0 cannot be read as n/n; source=null means no primary artifact is named.

L2_numerical.claim: anchor_violation is 0.0 for ontology, 0.0 for ontology_lora and 0.125 for syncraft, with source=null.
L2_numerical.caveat: No denominator is reported; 0.0 cannot be read as 0/n; source=null.

L2_numerical.claim: Reasoner inference counts are: A21 hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL 115; A19 hasFailureRisk 231; A20 hasProtectedAtom 363; defined class ValidatedEditSequence 78; defined class StereocenterPreservingReaction 2; StereocenterAnchor contract 320.
owlrl expands the triple store from 10400 to 23113 triples.
L2_numerical.derived_check: 23113 − 10400 = 12713 materialised triples (arithmetic on the two reported figures only).

L2_numerical.claim: Reported scale: 3272 CQ cases across 14 batches; 2783 crossdocked molecules; n_molecules 3483; n_evidence 79; papers 7; transforms_freed 5/5; rl_pool 5174.
External literature reference point: SynCraft reports P2M 28.4% / ResGen 29.1% rescue at similarity>0.6 with Gemini-2.5-Pro (arXiv 2512.20333).
L2_numerical.caveat: This is a third-party reported number, not a measurement of this pipeline, and it is a rescue rate at similarity>0.6 — a different metric and operating point from end2edit_validity.

L2_numerical.claim: Seven PDB structure entries are listed: 5KB3, 5IRU, 5J2M, 5JJK, 5JXG, 5K3S, 5IAR.
L2_numerical.caveat: CONTEXT gives the identifiers only; it does not state which claim each structure supports.

tdal.definition_status: CONTEXT does not define the TDAL dimensions. The operationalisation below is stated explicitly so it can be corrected; all four scores are this phase's judgement anchored to CONTEXT fields, not measurements.

T_traceability.definition: fraction of ladder claims that cite a named CONTEXT artifact and could be re-derived from it
T_traceability.justification: All L1 and L2 claims cite a named field. Deductions: end2edit_validity and anchor_violation carry source=null; literature.structure_papers gives identifiers with no claim linkage; 'transforms_freed' and 'hardOK_48api' are undefined terms; the TDAL definition itself is absent.

D_determinism_reproducibility.definition: extent to which the reported results could be re-run and would reproduce
D_determinism_reproducibility.justification: CONTEXT contains no seeds, code, configuration, environment, ontology IRI, per-run variance, confidence intervals or denominators. owlrl expansion (10400→23113) is deterministic in principle but the ontology is not supplied. The only dispersion information is the 6/6 and 7/7 win counts.

A_adequacy_attribution.definition: extent to which the cited evidence is sufficient to support the claim it is attached to, and correctly attributed
A_adequacy_attribution.justification: Headline rates 1.0/1.0/0.0/0.0 lack denominators and provenance; significance rests on 6 and 7 paired wins; no binding-interaction measurement although the question requires it; no ablation separating ontology from ontology_lora; literature.syncraft is correctly attributed as external but is at a different operating point, so no head-to-head attribution is possible.

L_logical_consistency.definition: absence of internal contradiction among ladder claims and between ladder and CONTEXT
L_logical_consistency.justification: No contradiction found. The ontology>baseline ordering is consistent across hardOK_48api (0.875 vs 0.5/0.5), end2edit_validity (1.0/1.0 vs 0.5) and anchor_violation (0.0/0.0 vs 0.125). The derived sign-test check is consistent with one-sided exact tests. The only tension is scope: the question's binding-interaction requirement has no corresponding measurement, which is an adequacy gap rather than a contradiction.

tdal.weakest_dimension_rationale: Determinism/Reproducibility is the binding constraint: even a perfectly traceable and internally consistent claim set cannot be re-derived because no denominators, seeds, configuration, ontology artifact or provenance are present for the two headline comparison dicts.
tdal.joint_interpretation: Multiplicative joint means the weakest dimension dominates; a single low score caps the whole claim set. Remediation priority is therefore D first (publish denominators, source artifacts, seeds/config), then A (add a binding-interaction metric and an ontology-vs-ontology_lora ablation).

full_response.verdict_rationale: The symbolic layer is fully traceable: the ontology defines ValidatedEditSequence, StereocenterPreservingReaction and the StereocenterAnchor contract, and owlrl materialises hasFailureRisk, hasProtectedAtom and hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL inferences (reasoner_inferences). The numerical layer is directionally consistent (ontology 0.875 vs similarity/random 0.5 on hardOK_48api; end2edit_validity 1.0/1.0 vs syncraft 0.5; anchor_violation 0.0/0.0 vs syncraft 0.125), but both headline comparison dicts carry source=null and no denominators, so the 1.0/0.0 rates cannot be converted into counts or intervals. The qualitative layer must be downgraded on three fronts: (a) 'binding interactions preserved' has no corresponding measurement anywhere in CONTEXT; (b) 'stereochemistry preserved' rests on a defined class with only 2 instances (定义类 StereocenterPreservingReaction: 2); (c) 'outperforms SynCraft' is not licensed because literature.syncraft reports rescue rates at similarity>0.6 under Gemini-2.5-Pro, a different metric and operating point. Joint TDAL = 0.80*0.25*0.35*0.85 = 0.0595, weakest_dimension = D (Determinism/Reproducibility). Not FAIL because no claim is contradicted and the core ontology-grounding artifacts exist; not PASS because headline rates lack provenance and denominators and the binding-interaction requirement is unmeasured.
